source: SPM 2026 Trial – Negeri Sembilan – English Paper 2 · Part 2 · Question 2 · Essay (125–150 words)
paragraphs: Helping others is one of the most rewarding things a person can do. One activity I do to help people is volunteering at a soup kitchen every Saturday. My friends and I serve hot meals to the homeless in Seremban town.

First and foremost, I help others because I believe that everyone deserves a second chance in life. Many of the people I meet lost their homes due to circumstances beyond their control. Furthermore, I help others because it gives me a deep sense of fulfilment. Seeing their grateful smiles warms my heart.

Helping people can change a person by making them more grateful for what they have. I no longer complain about trivial matters such as food I dislike. Moreover, it nurtures empathy and humility. As a result, we learn to treat everyone with kindness and respect, regardless of their background.
